name: Ming Ming
source:
The head of the powerful criminal organisation Longhai Yang and [url=https://vndb.org/c21590]Wang Wenli's[/url] main opponent for the title of the king of heidao.
[url=https://vndb.org/c21589]Li Wei's[/url] older sister.
She left her family estate 10 years prior to the events of the story, after being denied the headship of the house. Although she was stronger than her brothers, her father didn't want a female successor. Ming Ming killed her eldest brother and cut her father's arm in revenge. Then she traveled to Anluojie following the advice of an old family servant.
[spoiler]She's the niece of the previous king of the underworld and Wang Wenli's cousin.[spoiler]
